display.purpose: Page-level greetings — Dashboard "Good morning," Plans header.

title.purpose: Large numeric values — plan prices, stat-tile figures. Tabular-nums.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked labels — stat-tile labels, sidebar section headers.

mono.purpose: Tabular data that must not shift width — call timers, score numbers.

shadows.name: ambient-interactive
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus/floating-surface elevation. PINNED FOR REMOVAL per the Zero-Shadow Rule target — currently still in use, described as the honest before-state, not a feature to preserve.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus visibility. Kept even under the Zero-Shadow target — accessibility affordance, not a depth shadow.

shadows.name: live-pulse
shadows.value: animated box-shadow ring, var(--live-soft) to transparent (@keyframes coach-pulse)
shadows.purpose: The app's signature live-indicator language. Kept under Zero-Shadow — motion/signal, not static depth.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brand acting — main call-to-action across the app.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--grad); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 11px 18px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -6px var(--accent); transition: transform 0.28s var(--ease); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); outline: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sits visually behind Primary — card-elevated fill, full-opacity border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--card-2); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 11px 18px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.28s var(--ease); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent-border); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); outline: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Solid danger fill — reserved for destructive confirmation only.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--danger); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 11px 18px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--danger-soft); outline: none; }

components.name: Dashboard Card
components.description: Default card — flat at rest, border does the resting depth work.
components.html:
Recent calls

Your last 5 coached calls appear here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: var(--card-pad); } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--card-2); border-color: var(--border-2); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed inset background — focus shifts the border to accent plus the violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--inset); border: 1px solid var(--border-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 10px 14px; color: var(--text); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); outline: none; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active state is a violet pill wash, color only — no border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--card-2); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-text); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Lifeline / Smart Replies Card
components.description: Signature component — up to three AI-suggested reply lines during a live call, each copyable. Persists until manually dismissed; never auto-hides. Floating variant uses glass material (blur + saturate) because it sits directly over live page content; the docked PiP variant stays opaque.
components.html: Live suggestions
components.css: .ds-lifeline { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-2) 72%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border-top, var(--border-2)); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 16px; } .ds-lifeline-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--live); margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-lifeline-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--live); animation: coach-pulse 1.6s ease-out infinite; } .ds-lifeline-reply { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text-body); font-size: 0.86rem; margin-bottom: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lifeline-reply:hover { border-color: var(--accent-border); } @keyframes coach-pulse { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--live-soft);} 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px transparent; } }

narrative.overview:
HusAI's current visual system is a dark-first (with a fully-designed light counterpart), violet-anchored interface built for a moment of real pressure: a VA on a live call, needing calm, precise help without visual noise. The system leans toward Raycast's control-panel precision and Linear's restraint, layered with a single warm signal color (violet→indigo) that means "this is the brand acting on your behalf," and a second, deliberately rarer color (fuchsia) that means "the AI is live right now." Everything else — text, borders, surfaces — stays neutral so those two signals stand out when they appear.

Pinned reference (binding, partially carried out): Raycast's actual UI achieves depth with zero drop shadows — a pure surface-color ladder where each layer reads as "one step forward" than the last — plus 1px hairline borders, a 96px section rhythm, and a hard rule that any saturated accent appears at most once per page. HusAI adopts this depth/spacing/restraint philosophy, while keeping violet/indigo (never Raycast's red) as the one accent color, per the Two-Signal Rule.
keyCharacteristics: Two-signal color language: violet for brand/action, fuchsia strictly for "AI is active right now"
Flat-at-rest, lift-on-interaction elevation (borders do the resting work; shadow is reserved for hover/focus feedback)
Generous fluid spacing driven by clamp(), so density adapts smoothly rather than snapping at breakpoints

A recurring pulsing-dot motif (coach-pulse) is the signature "something live is happening" language, reused identically across the LIVE nav badge, sidebar active-call status, and the floating coach header

rules.name: The Once-Per-Page Rule
rules.body: A saturated accent — the violet gradient fill, or a fuchsia live indicator — appears at full strength at most once in a given viewport of a page. Implemented on Dashboard/Sidebar. Chart/data-encoding color is a separate category and not covered.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet = the brand acting. Fuchsia = the AI acting live, right now. A third saturated color is never introduced for pure decoration. Enforced.

rules.name: The Section-Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Pinned target, not yet implemented. Major sections on a page are separated by a fixed 96px gap, never a fluid one — spacing within a section still scales with --gap.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Pinned target, supersedes Rest-Is-Flat. No element carries a box-shadow for depth, at rest or on interaction — depth comes exclusively from the surface-color ladder and hairline borders. Focus rings and the live-pulse animation are exempt.

rules.name: The Rest-Is-Flat Rule
rules.body: Current, partially superseded. Surfaces carry a border, never a shadow, at rest. The remaining gap (interactive hover shadow) is retired by the Zero-Shadow Rule.

dos: Do treat violet as the only "brand action" color and fuchsia as the only "AI is live" color — never swap their roles.
Do keep cards and rows flat (border only) at rest; add the Ambient Interactive shadow only on hover/focus/floating states.
Do use the uppercase, tracked Label style for section headers and stat labels — it's the app's one consistent all-caps convention.
Do let spacing scale fluidly with clamp() rather than jumping at fixed breakpoints.
donts: Don't introduce a third saturated brand color for decoration. Anything that isn't violet, fuchsia, or a strict danger/warning status stays neutral gray.
Don't apply a resting shadow to a card or tile — that's reserved for interaction, per the Rest-Is-Flat Rule.
Don't recolor an icon or status element to violet/fuchsia when its real-world meaning is something else (destructive, warning, success) — semantic color always wins over brand color.
Don't use the pill/999px radius on anything that isn't a status chip, badge, or toggle.
